title: Catalog Product Sets
content_data:
> **Important**
By using Catalog API endpoints, you agree to the [Product Catalog Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/article?aid=6765817026859499525) and certify that you are abiding by the [TikTok Advertising Policies](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=6685586866860720134). Please review these policies and ensure that the items you upload to your catalog don't breach them. A catalog is an asset that allows you to store information about the products you want to promote on TikTok. Using a catalog is a great solution for anyone who is looking for an efficient way to create and manage ads that feature a variety of products, like an online retailer. Catalog Product Sets API enables you to manage product sets in a catalog under your Business Center. See [Overview](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263078057986) and [Guides](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263100123137) to learn about the concepts and benefits of catalogs, and to find out how to create and manage catalogs. This group consists of the following endpoints: * [Get product sets](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740570556295169) * [Get products in product set](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740571478441986) * [Create a product set by conditions](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740572891104257) * [Create a product set by file](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1846770644217858) * [Update a product set](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740572974725122) * [Delete product sets](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740573143966722)
